pages.text: Any affix material can be $(l)forged into a weapon or armor$() on an altar, making it a $(l)pseudo alchemical treasure$().$(br2)$(li)Weapons: swords, axes, bows, crossbows, tridents, other mods' weapons$(li)Armor: helmets, chestplates, leggings, boots, other mods' armor$(li)One affix a piece$(li)It escapes half of the Sage's curse (see below)

$(l)Ordinary affixes$()$(br)Transmutation altar: the weapon (main), the affix material, 2 alchemical source ingots, 4 alchemical essence.$(br2)Held in the main hand, it works as if that affix's accessory were worn: its effect and its ward alike.

$(l)Boss affixes$()$(br)Truth altar: the weapon (main), the boss material, truth essence, 4 alchemical source ingots, 8 alchemical essence.$(br2)$(li)Pride: +50% damage to targets with a smaller share of health left$(li)Greed: +1 Looting, 5% life steal$(li)Sloth: hits slow and tire$(li)Envy: 15% to steal a beneficial effect
$(li)Wrath: +10% damage per 10% of your health missing$(li)Gluttony: kills heal 10% of the victim's max health and feed you$(li)Lust: knocking a non-boss below 15% health executes it

pages.title: The Sage's Curse
pages.text: A pseudo treasure escapes half the curse:$(li)Weapons: anything but an alchemical treasure deals 50%; a pseudo one deals $(l)75%$() (a true treasure still 100%)$(li)Armor: the Nether's curse voids armor; pseudo alchemical armor keeps $(l)50%$() of its armor and toughness

pages.title: Armor
pages.text: $(l)Ordinary$(): transmutation altar, the armor (main), the material, 2 alchemical source ingots, 2 alchemical source string, 2 alchemical essence.$(br)$(l)Boss$(): truth altar, the armor (main), the boss material, truth essence, 3 ingots, 3 string, 6 essence.$(br2)Armor gives $(l)no ward$(), but every material a power; the same affix on more pieces (n) is stronger.

Space: when struck, 8%×n to blink a few blocks away (5 s cooldown)$(br2)Time: Rewind health by 5s on lethal damage, capped at 50% max health; 360/n s cooldown$(br2)Armor Pierce: your blows deal 10%×n of the target's armor as extra damage
Causality: Projectile damage +15%×n$(br2)Regeneration: Heal 0.5×n every 3s$(br2)Curse: attackers 10%×n to suffer a random harmful effect for 5 s
Summon: falling under half health calls n wolves to your side for 30 s (60 s cooldown)$(br2)Seal: attackers 10%×n to have their affixes sealed for 5 s$(br2)Magic: Damage +8%×n after armor
Reflection: 8%×n of the physical harm you take goes back to the attacker$(br2)Damage Cap: Hits capped at (80−10×n)% max health$(br2)Strength: Attack +2 per piece
Resistance: +5% damage reduction a piece$(br2)Split: falling under 30% hides you for 3 s and the mobs round you lose you (60/n s cooldown)$(br2)Physical Resistance: Physical damage −8%×n

Non-physical Resistance: All non-physical damage −7%×n$(br2)Thunder: 10%×n to strike attackers for 4 + 2% of their max health (percentage part capped at 40)$(br2)Slowness: attackers 25%×n to be slowed (II) for 3 s

Shared: 8%×n of the harm you take is spread over the hostile mobs within 6 blocks$(br2)Healing: Every 5s heal nearby players for n + 1%×n of your max health$(br2)Malice: your blows 10%×n to turn the mobs round you on your target

Desaturation: hostile mobs within (8+4×n) blocks glow$(br2)Void: Dodge 3%×n, halved against bosses; adds to accessory/core dodge, sharing 3s cooldown when a core is worn$(br2)Ruin: Kills burst within 3 blocks for 15%×n of victim max health; cannot chain

Shatter: your blows 10%×n to stagger (Slowness IV, Weakness II for 1 s) and break a raised shield$(br2)Undying: a lethal blow is cheated as with a Totem of Undying (900/n s cooldown)$(br2)Blood Pact: heal 3%×n of the damage you deal

Growth: Golden blood capacity per piece: 4 + 5% actual max health; combined cap 120%. After 5s without being hit, regenerate 2 + Gluttony pieces per second. Absorption first, then golden blood; invulnerability-bypassing damage skips it
Enlightenment: experience picked up +15%×n$(br2)Befuddlement: non-boss attackers 10%×n to lose you$(br2)Amplify: beneficial effects on you last 15%×n longer
Mastery: Attack speed +8% per piece$(br2)Pride: At ≥80% health, damage +12%×n$(br2)Wrath: Each 10% missing health reduces damage by 1.5%×n, minimum damage multiplier ×0.60

Envy: attackers 10%×n to be robbed of a beneficial effect (or you gain Strength for 5 s)$(br2)Greed: experience from your kills +20%×n$(br2)Lust: Execute non-boss, non-player attackers below 20% health with 8%×n chance

Gluttony: Golden blood capacity per piece: 2 + 2% actual max health; combined cap 120%. After 5s without being hit, regenerate 2 + Gluttony pieces per second. Absorption first, then golden blood; invulnerability-bypassing damage skips it
Sloth: Only while stationary: damage taken −8%×n
Only Amplify in an accessory slot grants ×1.4 to one dimension per effect; Time, Split and Summon only shorten cooldowns; excludes static attributes and Growth
